Pixar is one of the most successful companies creating movies today. Youve probably seen at least one of their huge hits, movies such as Toy Story, Monsters, Inc., Cars, or WallE. Ever since Steve Jobs, founder of Apple Computers, bought the company from George Lucas, creator of Star Wars, Pixar has changed the way animated movies are made. Steve has turned the company into something incredible. Discover the story of how Steve gave Pixar the chance to make their first movies, how Pixar changed Hollywoodand how Pixar hopes to keep on amazing moviegoers in the future
